title: Transfer: Storm Outage Islanding Triage
goal: Given a MATPOWER network snapshot and a list of storm-outaged transmission lines, generate `islanding_triage.json` that lists each post-contingency island, its stranded load, surviving generation, isolated buses, and the outage lines responsible for the split.
skillBenefitRationale: Success hinges on converting MATPOWER branch records into a graph, preserving bus-number mappings, and recomputing island-level load and generation totals directly from the parsed network data.
